uncertainty_flags.detail: Additional work items under the Siemens Healthineers and Comcast client project blocks (dashboards, import sets, access controls, ITSM modules, scripting) are captured as project descriptions; their assignment to Virtusa employment is implied by project layout but the local categories label them 'summary'.
Contact line contains icon glyph artifacts ((cid:131), (cid:239), # and * separators); email and phone extracted from the text only.
The value 4 years is the self-stated experience in the summary; no tenure was calculated. Start date May 2022 to Present is retained as given.
Virtusa Pvt. Ltd. is the employer; Siemens Healthineers and Comcast are client/project names under the employer block, not separate employers.
Technologies sourced from the 'Technology Used' line for the Siemens Healthineers project.
